messages:
javier-csm: Quick sync — we found ~120 EMEA onboarding tenants impacted by the weekend embeddings delay. Several are in renewal windows. Proposing a localized comm + targeted remediation offering (translation + regional office hours + tailored credit). Thoughts?

meera-cs: Strong +1. EMEA customers respond better to local-language comms. Can we get translated email copy (EN/FR/DE) and a localized calendar (CET slots)? Also suggest a short 20-30s video clip in each language summarizing next steps.

rachel-ops: Ops can support CET office hours M-F 09:00 & 15:00 CET for the next two weeks. We'll provide dedicated escalation channel for top 15 renewal-risk tenants.

sam-eng: From infra: confirmed embeddings ingestion lag caused by a backfill race condition. We rolled mitigations; long-running backfills are now on a controlled queue. No data loss observed. Recommend we advise customers not to re-run full ingest unless support recommends.

francis-ml: Adding: small integrity check customers can run to validate vector counts + sample similarity. Snippet below (paste into Console):
```python
# get vector count for index
resp = client.embeddings.count_vectors(index_name=\"my-index\")
print(resp)
```
Include that in comms and link to a KB article.

javier-csm: Draft localized subject lines: EN: \"Update: Embeddings onboarding delay — complimentary support & next steps\" FR: \"Mise à jour: Délai d'indexation des embeddings — support gratuit et prochaines étapes\" DE: \"Update: Verzögerung bei Embeddings-Indexierung — kostenloser Support & nächste Schritte\"

meera-cs: Nice. For the body, add a clear bold line: \"If you see normal search results, no action required.\" Also provide a short escalation template they can paste into support:
```text
Subject: Embedding integrity check request
Tenant: <tenant-id>
Observed: <missing/mismatched results or counts>
Preferred contact window: <CET window>
```

rachel-ops: We'll auto-open a support ticket for any customer who clicks \"Request 1:1\" and tag it with INC-EMEA-2024. Incident-bot will create refs.

sam-eng: Also propose a temporary goodwill credit band for impacted tenants tied to monthly usage: small, medium, large buckets. Finance OK'd an initial slate; CS to propose final amounts per account.

javier-csm: I'll assemble a prioritized list (renewal <60d, 60-120d, >120d). Meera, can you draft the translated emails? Aim to send first wave to <60d tomorrow 08:00 CET.

meera-cs: Yes — I'll do EN/FR/DE. Can ops confirm the CET calendar link and regional reps?

rachel-ops: Calendar: https://cal.redwood.ai/emea-embeddings (3x slots/day). Regional rep list attached in internal doc. Also setting up a 15-min pre-brief channel for reps.

francis-ml: For transparency add a tiny technical appendix link to the RCA in the email footer for customers who want details. Also recommend we include a one-click diagnostic that triggers an automated vector count check (internal endpoint). Example API call:
```bash
curl -X POST https://status.redwood.ai/api/v1/diagnostics \n -H \"Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY\" \n -d '{\"tenant\":\"<tenant>\",\"check\":\"vector_count\"}'
```

meera-cs: Draft email body (EN):
\"Hello <Customer name>,

We experienced an embeddings onboarding delay over the weekend that affected indexing for a subset of tenants in EMEA. Our engineers have mitigated the issue and we have not observed data loss.

If your search results look normal, no action is required. If you notice missing results or mismatched behavior, please: 1) click Request 1:1 to schedule a remediation call, or 2) paste the escalation template into support.

We're offering: a complimentary 45-minute localized workshop (EN/FR/DE), a recorded replay in your language, and a goodwill credit for impacted tenants in renewal windows.

Link to schedule: https://cal.redwood.ai/emea-embeddings
Technical appendix & RCA (publishing soon): https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/EMEA-2024-11

We appreciate your patience.
Best,
Redwood Customer Success\"

javier-csm: Looks good. Add line for high-touch: \"If your renewal is <60 days, we will proactively reach out to schedule a 1:1.\"

rachel-ops: Action items now: 1) javier to share prioritized list by 18:00 CET; 2) meera to upload EN/FR/DE email drafts + short video clips by 17:00 CET; 3) ops to confirm calendar + escalation channel; 4) francis/sam to publish diagnostic endpoint and sign-off text by EOD.

incident-bot: Support ticket group INC-EMEA-2024 created and linked to conversation.

meera-cs: Also adding quick post-session survey questions: 1) Was the workshop helpful? (yes/no), 2) Rate the clarity of next steps (1-5), 3) Would you like a follow-up 1:1? (yes/no). We'll keep it max 3 items for response rate.

javier-csm: Perfect. Let's send the first batch tomorrow 08:00 CET to <60d cohort and monitor replies for urgent escalations. We'll reconvene here after first wave. :pray:
